claims.title: A conditional polarizability-to-mass certificate bounds closed voids while physical acquisition remains open

interface: Conditional implication phi<=1-K/R_U; high R is inconclusive; no efficient instrument or accepted yield guaranteed.
limits: First recover and independently review the imported electrostatic inequality and conditional derivations. Then demonstrate a blinded single-particle certificate: acquire a conservatively covered upper bound on Tr(alpha)/m and valid per-particle material/coating premises with fixed calibration and independent void ground truth. Rotation, phase motion, optical versus mass center, finite electrodes, charge and neighbors require actual error bounds; industrial throughput follows only after this acquisition gate.
status: Source-reported conditional derivations and reduced-model diagnostics only. No transformative technology, instrument, experimental validation, matched performance advantage or historical originality was established. Intake checks preservation and architecture, not scientific correctness; the measurement/acquisition gate remains open.
